name: CWA World Championship
epitaph: The top belt of the CWA of 2007 and 2008. Its own cards open the run with Wren SilverPhoenix on 23 October 2007, and Tommy Purr and Jack Spade trade it into mid-2008. It is a new run of titles: the belt of 2003 and 2004 is another wing’s, and the two lists share no champion.

name: CWA Aerial Championship
epitaph: The cruiserweight belt of the revived CWA, in which 6Pac Dudley, Thibor Dragosani and Hoshi Yakamoto are its holders through 2008, as the cards of that year show.

name: CWA Diva Championship
epitaph: A Diva title on the revived CWA’s 2008 front page, held by Bombshell from 29 June 2008.

name: CWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The tag belts of the revived CWA: the New Age Dogg Pound won them at Battle of the Warriors 2008 on 15 January 2008 and lost them to Sex and Violence on 11 March.
